exp_0: Lord who delights the heart of Goddess Lakshmi (Ramaa).
exp_1: Graciously arriving here from the great Venkatachala hill (Tirupati).
exp_2: In Kalasa, the holy place established by Sage Agastya.
exp_3: In Kalasapura, the most prominent and supreme among towns in that land.
exp_5: Look upon your devoted worshippers with your merciful gaze and protect them.
exp_6: Lord Brahma, born from the lotus.
exp_7: Lord Shiva, the destroyer of the universe.
exp_10: As they bow down in line, their crowns touch and rub against the Lord's footstool.
exp_11: Residing in a magnificent hall built of pure melted gold.
exp_12: O Lord of the beautiful town of Kalasa, I offer my prostrations to you.
exp_13: Having a pure white color like Kunda flowers, the moon, and cow's milk.
exp_14: The service of two white chauris (fly-whisks) attached to fine golden handles.
exp_15: A pair of royal scepters as magnificent as the body of Adishesha.
exp_16: O ocean of mercy, kindly look upon and accept this grand service.
exp_17: Piercing and destroying all darkness in the world.
exp_19: Shining equal to the splendor of the sun and blazing fire.
exp_21: This grand Aarti lamp with five faces/flames.
exp_22: O Lord of Lakshmi, kindly accept this auspicious lamp offering.
exp_32: Along with various types of Zharzhara (jingling bronze gongs).
exp_33: May the Lord listen to the melodious sounds of all these musical instruments.
